reserveReview.rationale: Sygnum identifies each FIUSD as one unit of Fidelity Institutional Liquidity Fund USD Fund Class G Acc. The official September 25, 2026 USD Fund holdings report, page 3, supplies a complete $10,331,299,067.20 fund-portfolio denominator and six reported security-type percentages totaling 100.00%. These are dated per-unit look-through fund allocations, not a FIUSD-token-supply-to-held-fund-units reconciliation or token-scoped assurance. They are not the separate Fidelity USD Treasury Fund, GBP Fund, or a maturity/redemption guarantee. Existing medium risk classifications are retained; issuer-specific exposure, whole-position liquidation and contractual maturity maxima are not inferred from aggregate categories, WAM, or WAL.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Exact FIUSD Class G fund-unit claim; dated full USD Fund portfolio security-type allocation, without token-unit reconciliation or assurance inference
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The dated September 25 Fidelity USD Fund report classifies security types; exact current FIUSD unit-to-token attribution, custody/subcustody allocation, executable liquidity and instrument-specific exposure remain unresolved. Source-maintenance check 2026-10-07: the official fidelity.ie ILF holdings PDF is reachable despite other Fidelity/Sygnum 403 responses. Parse the USD fund section, not separate GBP/EUR or USD Treasury funds. This whole-fund security inventory does not establish token-scoped shares or reconciliation. Preserve configured portfolio-scope exclusion and existing 48-hour source/fetch fallback; report publication cadence is independently unverified. General fund-unit descriptions do not authorize a scope change or fresh composition claim.
